scope: Prepare and live-verify one fixed trusted guest privilege-drop probe; preserve actual owner-authorized session evidence and no generated execution authority.
riskAnalysis: The fixed builder never dispatches commands or creates resources. Its sudo flag is trusted future control-plane metadata, not an agent grant. Live qualification ran only reviewed immutable trusted source in one pinned-image temporary VM; all authority/qualification flags remain false. Full application source-batch qualification pending.

threatModel.assets: Credential isolation, guest privilege boundaries, trusted binaries and truthful evidence.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Trusted controller root wrapper drops to65534 before executing the fixed probe; models cannot select argv or access the controller.
threatModel.abuseCases: Command substitution, inherited supplementary groups/capabilities, forged metadata, source truncation or false full-qualification claims.
threatModel.mitigations: Two exact Node paths, fixed setpriv arguments, closed output requiring nine booleans and complete code SHA; protected binary/ancestors, one serial session with stop+independent readback.

rollback: Remove the unused fixed probe builder if later qualification finds a problem. Preserve actual observed results and historical evidence. No live application integration or Production change exists.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extends existing fixed qualification plan with one probe, not another controller or execution system.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Only Node built-ins; Linux setpriv is checked in managed image and no software installed.
proactiveReview.threats: Privileged preparation must never become arbitrary root execution. Exact immutable trusted argv and no provider integration preserve this boundary.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Missing/duplicate/false privilege fields fail the probe. A passing privilege probe never grants full execution qualification.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Root62focused checks plus independent QA14adversarial/Auditor9path-hash checks; real Linux nine-fact probe passed with exact source SHA.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent offline and actual Work QA/Auditor passed; Auditor separately GET-confirmed stopped state and approved distinct-UID binary protection.
proactiveReview.recovery: One new session stopped, no routes/snapshots. No model calls, generated code, publication or historical grant reuse.
proactiveReview.readiness: Privilege drop actually verified. Full filesystem/resource/network/cancellation and application release qualification remain pending; no automatic execution admission.
